explanation: Feature 318 Amendments 2-3: option A, the ways laid in the gaps once every house stands (settlement/rolling/gap_ways.py: a lane-ground raster, one flood from the way out, a per-household way out, traced, pulled taut and admitted by the corridor's own predicate and the tree's lane law), replacing the per-seat corridor search. The growth sits in the homesteads stage (+0.3 to +0.9 s a map in the bookend), the gap pass's own cost; the tie-break (FR-003a) removed the first amendment's field-first cost. The GM chose option A knowing it measured slower (spec FR-015: 'I still want A for how it shapes the map'). Prototype per-stage A/B, research R4: homesteads stage over nine nucleated seeds main 9.85 s, tie-break alone 9.96 s, option A 14.38 s.
